examples.title: AgenC task roundtrip - three.ws + Solana devnet
examples.description: End-to-end demonstration of a three.ws agent participating in the AgenC coordination protocol on Solana devnet. A creator wallet posts a task; a worker wallet (the "three.ws agent") claims and completes it.

examples.title: Agent-native 3D - create, embody, and distribute, end to end
examples.description: An agent given a goal ("get yourself a body") generates the 3D assets it needs and uses them - no browser, no mocks, no human in the loop.

examples.title: Coach Leo
examples.description: A complete, minimal example of a three.ws agent defined entirely as files: a manifest pointing at a 3D body, a brain, a voice, a memory policy, and one installed skill.

examples.title: Example skills
examples.description: Six installable skill bundles for the three.ws agent runtime.

examples.title: MetaMask Agent Wallet demo
examples.description: A single-page demo that gives a three.ws agent a real server-side wallet through the MetaMask Agentic CLI (mm).

examples.title: Monica's Apartment (Friends) - first-person Three.js scene
examples.description: A single, self-contained HTML file that rebuilds the iconic Monica Geller apartment set from Friends as a walkable first-person 3D scene: purple walls, the purple front door with the yellow peephole frame, teal kitchen cabinets, the mismatched dining chairs,

examples.description: A complete, runnable MCP server whose tools charge per call in USDC on Solana over x402. It ships two tools on purpose:
examples.run: cd examples/paid-mcp-server && npm install && npm run start

examples.title: Pump Agent
examples.description: An example agent manifest that composes all four production pump.fun skills into one 3D trading agent: swap, coin creation, creator-fee collection, and token payments.

examples.title: Trinity, the three.ws concierge
examples.description: The reference agent for manifest spec agent-manifest/0.2. Trinity welcomes users to three.ws, explains the platform, and launches and trades $three on pump.fun through the real pump.fun skills in pump-fun-skills/.

examples.title: Wallet sign-in
examples.description: A single-page, no-build demo of the two wallet authentication rails three.ws runs itself: Sign-In with Solana (SIWS) and Sign-In with Ethereum (SIWE).

examples.title: @three-ws/agentcore-payments-mcp

examples.title: @three-ws/assistant

examples.title: @three-ws/avatar
examples.description: A self-contained page, no build step. It loads the SDK's @three-ws/avatar/agent entry from a CDN, awaits ensureAgent3D() to register the <agent-3d> element, and renders the real three.ws default avatar using the documented src and kiosk attributes.
